skseGate.name: WeatherBehavior
skseGate.author: bottle
skseGate.v5BitExplanation: The absent AddressLibraryV5 bit is not a defect. This project declares itself through CommonLibSSE-NG's newer SKSEPluginInfo/PluginDeclaration API, whose StructCompatibility field occupies offset 0x304 - the same offset PluginVersionData calls versionIndependenceEx - and whose Independent value is 1. SKSE only treats a missing V5 bit as fatal when the PE TimeDateStamp falls in [520128000, 1748217600); this build stamps 2026-09-02 and passes on the stamp. The vendor 1.0.1 DLL declares the identical viEx=1 and SKSE admits it too, which is precisely why the static gate was never the discriminator here.
skseGate.compatibleVersionsNote: Not a real compatible-version list and not read by SKSE here. CommonLibSSE-NG's PluginDeclaration stores RuntimeCompatibility as std::array<VersionNumber,16> _compatibleVersions{} (include/SKSE/Interfaces.h), and VersionNumber default-constructs to major=1 (a_major = 1 in its default arguments), so value-initialising the array yields sixteen 0x01000000 entries. audit/skse_version_data.py reads that region at the PluginVersionData offset and prints them. SKSE ignores the array entirely when kVersionIndependent_AddressLibraryPostAE is set, which it is. The vendor 1.0.1 DLL shows the identical sixteen entries.

distribution.basis: BLOCKED ON UPSTREAM LICENCE. The upstream repository carries no licence file and the Nexus page carries no structured permission grant - only the author's instruction 'please ask i probably wont say no'. Under docs/PATCH_INTENTS.md and the #160 eligibility ruling, vendorBytesAllowed covers permissive licences or a quoted upload permission, and this has neither, so the artifact may run on this machine and may not be packaged, uploaded, or forked. The upstream vcpkg.json declares "license": "MIT", which is evidence of intent but not a grant: MIT requires a copyright and permission notice to be reproduced, and none exists to reproduce. CommonLibSSE-NG's own GPL-3.0-or-later + modding linking exception is satisfied and is not the constraint.

A drafted message is staged in records/cloak-framework-rebuild-2026-09-02.md - NOT SENT; contacting the author is the user's call.
